data.body: [P2] Complete coverage of the reporting entry point. These tests call the helpers directly and never reach `main()`'s new PR/baseline gate or error handler. Removing the comment call entirely, or removing the baseline guard so a failed baseline lookup clears an existing warning, leaves every added test unchanged. The prior coverage finding therefore remains partially unresolved under CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the validation design under rule 9 and cover entry-point posting, absent PR/baseline, and API-write failures.
